meta.name: consulting-writing
meta.description: Management-consulting writing craft — McKinsey SCR (Situation·Complication·Resolution), Minto Pyramid/MECE, BCG bold-bullet executive summary, so-what upfront, numeric precision, Forrester Landscape. Use when writing or reviewing an executive summary for decision-makers or a roll-up/landscape overview, or when a conclusion-first compressed structure, MECE completeness, or bold-bullet summary is needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用麦肯锡金字塔结构写出决策者爱看的摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为决策者撰写或润色结构清晰的商业摘要
copy.tagline_en: Write executive summaries with McKinsey pyramid structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or polish structured summaries for decision-makers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照管理咨询写作规范来撰写或审阅内容：使用 SCR（情境·挑战·方案）结构、MECE 原则、结论先行、粗体要点和数字精确表达。
howto.when: 当你需要为决策者撰写或审阅执行摘要、汇总报告或全景概览，或者需要结论优先的紧凑结构、MECE 完整性或粗体要点总结时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份执行摘要，用 SCR 结构：情境、挑战、方案。
say.note: Claude 会按 McKinsey 风格组织内容。

say.text: 检查这段文字是否满足 MECE 原则，列出遗漏或重叠的部分。
say.note: Claude 会分析并指出不互斥或不穷尽之处。

say.text: 把这段报告改成结论先行，并用粗体要点突出关键数据。
say.note: Claude 会调整结构，使结论在前，数据用粗体展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write or review content using management-consulting writing craft: SCR (Situation-Complication-Resolution), MECE principle, conclusion-first, bold-bullet summaries, and numeric precision.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing or reviewing an executive summary for decision-makers, a roll-up/landscape overview, or when a conclusion-first compressed structure, MECE completeness, or bold-bullet summary is needed.

say_en.text: Write an executive summary using SCR: Situation, Complication, Resolution.
say_en.note: Claude will structure content in McKinsey style.

say_en.text: Check this text for MECE completeness; list any overlaps or gaps.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and point out non-MECE parts.

say_en.text: Rewrite this report conclusion-first and highlight key numbers in bold bullets.
say_en.note: Claude will restructure with conclusion upfront and bold data.
